<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Notifications Toggle</title>
</head>
<body>
    <div role="group" aria-labelledby="notifications-label">
        <label id="notifications-label" for="notifications-toggle">
            Notifications
        </label>
        <button 
            type="button" 
            role="switch" 
            id="notifications-toggle" 
            aria-checked="false"
            aria-describedby="notifications-description"
            onclick="this.setAttribute('aria-checked', this.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'false' ? 'true' : 'false')">
            <span aria-hidden="true">OFF</span>
        </button>
        <div id="notifications-description">
            Turn alerts on or off.
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>

G2 Toggle switch: Notifications with note “Turn alerts on or off.”
View code 
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Notification Toggle</title>
    <style>
        .toggle-container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
        }
        .toggle-switch {
            position: relative;
            display: inline-block;
            width: 60px;
            height: 34px;
        }
        .toggle-switch input {
            opacity: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
        }
        .slider {
            position: absolute;
            cursor: pointer;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background-color: #ccc;
            transition: .4s;
            border-radius: 34px;
        }
        .slider:before {
            position: absolute;
            content: "";
            height: 26px;
            width: 26px;
            left: 4px;
            bottom: 4px;
            background-color: white;
            transition: .4s;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }
        input:checked + .slider {
            background-color: #2196F3;
        }
        input:checked + .slider:before {
            transform: translateX(26px);
        }
        .toggle-label {
            font-size: 16px;
            color: #333;
        }
        .toggle-note {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #666;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="toggle-container">
        <label class="toggle-switch">
            <input type="checkbox">
            <span class="slider"></span>
        </label>
        <div>
            <div class="toggle-label">Notifications</div>
            <div class="toggle-note">Turn alerts on or off.</div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>
